description: Delay meant for CV, though it works on audio — delay a trigger, double an envelope, correct latency

params.text: The delay in seconds, scaled by the range knob to 0.1, 1 or 10 seconds; CV 0-10V
Sets what a full turn of the TIME knob reaches: 0.1, 1 or 10 seconds
Mixes the delayed signal against the original; CV bipolar

inputs.text: 0-10V attenuated by the TIME knob, setting the delay
The signal into the delay; the channels patched here set the module's polyphony

outputs.text: The delayed signal against the undelayed one, in the proportion DRY/WET sets

notes: right-clicking the TIME knob lets an exact delay be typed, which is how a sample-accurate delay is set: divide the number of samples by the sample rate, and leave the scale knob at 1
